# kdbinsidebrains (data only)

`lib/help-builtins.tsv` took its NAME INVENTORY from the word CSVs of the
KdbInsideBrains IntelliJ plugin (https://github.com/kdbinsidebrains/plugin),
used under the Apache License 2.0 (see LICENSE in this directory), merged
2026-08-14 alongside TimeStored qstudio's built-in docs, contributed by their
owner. No code is vendored — only that dictionary data.

The TSV no longer carries the merged text: on 2026-08-14 it was rewritten to
three columns (name, call, meaning), every meaning worded in-repo against the
KX reference corpus in `qdocs/`, and every displayed result generated by
running the call through `./q` rather than copied from any corpus.
